notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a successful ordinary object registration service report. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM data elements, and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the standard HLAreportServiceInvocation payload and object discovery route without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador service-reporting controls and ordinary RegisterObjectInstance delivery with FederateAmbassador callbacks
